reuse.why: The flag is threaded into the existing shared isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden-inclusion rule is decided once inside isMonthFillCategory; actions only forward the flag.

placement.why: The change sits in the shared selection functions in server/budget/actions.ts, the layer that already owns which categories a month-wide action writes.

scope.why: Only the six month-wide actions, the selection helpers and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean single rule; the flag is a second boolean beside the scope enum and every action repeats the same destructuring default, but that is the requested public parameter.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six actions route through isMonthFillCategory (copyPreviousMonth directly, the rest via getMonthFillCategories).
